notes.title: 「100animalease」1st Anniversary Campaign
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for your continued patronage.
Today, “100animalease” celebrates its 1st anniversary since its release!

To commemorate the 1st anniversary, new illustrations drawn by the development staff are now available on woofHP!
Starting with the game creator "Sewo Hayami" who developed "100animalease",
We have released a new illustration drawn by our staff to commemorate the 1st anniversary, so please take a look.
https://www.woof.tokyo/100animalease1stanniv/

notes.title: Steam Awards 2023 & Sale on now!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing the action-adventure game '100animalease.' Through reviews and more, we're thrilled to see everyone embracing their unique ways of befriending or not befriending the 100 animals.


Voting for the 2023 Steam Awards has begun! If you're willing, please consider voting for us either at the top of this page or directly on the store page.


For those who haven't yet experienced '100animalease,' we're currently hosting a 50% OFF Steam Autumn Sale! Additionally, we've released a demo version to help more people discover the charm of this game.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2172410?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=2023_autumnsale&utm_medium=web


The demo's result screen showcases the animals you've befriended and your clear time. Feel free to share your experience by posting screenshots on social media using the hashtag #100animalease.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252257/b6a1b16df871bdbf888b41a75db5c9c996278173.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Released the demo version!
notes.notes:
In order to let as many people as possible know about the appeal of 100animalease, 
we have made a trial version available.

This trial version is a slightly improved version of the one that was available 
at TOKYO GAME SHOW 2023 held last month.

On the results screen, the animals that became companions and the clear time will be displayed.
Please post your screenshots on social media using #100animalease .

notes.title: Exhibited at TOKYO GAME SHOW 2023!
notes.notes:
100animalease will be exhibited for the first time at TOKYO GAME SHOW 2023, which will be held at Makuhari Messe for 4 days from September 21st (Thu) to September 24th (Sun), 2023.

In addition, 100animalease was also selected as one of the top 20 finalists of the Indie Game Festival 2023 hosted by Google Play.

At the TOKYO GAME SHOW, you can play the demo version of 100animalase in the booth.

You can actually enjoy an indie game that is attracting a lot of attention right now.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252257/e517589e849c2261044669ddd3c79ac28829f9a9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43252257/ed9bedd8716b105bb8ccde4d478da50506d37ebc.png[/img][/url]

Exhibit information and event schedules will be announced on the official X (Twitter) and official website.

Official X(Twitter) : https://twitter.com/wooftokyo

Official website : https://www.woof.tokyo/
